title: SREV-105 verify legacy certificate level compatibility

certificate_time_shape.description: Official and local certificate validity time-window shape

legacy_level_shape.description: Signed legacy level aliases accepted by the local Certificate.dat parser

source_change.description: Comment-only clarification preserving legacy level behavior

contracts: certificate validity is a time-window decision with not-before and not-after style boundaries
Windows system time is represented as UTC 100-nanosecond intervals in a LARGE_INTEGER-compatible time value
Certificate.dat is a local signed text contract and not an X.509 certificate chain
legacy LARGE MEDIUM and SMALL levels are parser compatibility aliases for already signed certificate text
LARGE assigns an explicit two-year expiration interval unless it is the pre-2022 semi-perpetual batch sentinel
MEDIUM keeps the default one-year expiration interval through the common expiration gate
SMALL maps to Home subscription before the common expiration gate
expiration_date drives expired and expirers_in_sec for non-eternal certificates
non-subscription certificates become outdated when expiration_date is older than BuildDate
subscription certificates are gated by expired while non-subscription certificates are gated by outdated
inactive certificates must be set inactive with STATUS_ACCOUNT_EXPIRED outside the grace period
this SREV must not remove legacy level branches or change certificate feature options
